name: run-loop-hint
description: Nudges the main session to hand a long run → read numbers → rerun Bash loop to a cheaper runner agent, never blocks: one context line on the Nth run in a row.

threshold.title: Runs in a row before the hint
threshold.description: How many run commands (npx, npm run/test, node <file>, python <file>, vitest, ffmpeg, gh run watch, …) the main session makes with no Agent or Workflow call and no new prompt before the hint is added; again every further N runs, at most 3 times per prompt.
